answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, tethering agent identity to capital rather than ephemeral digital signatures. By requiring agents to lock collateral, the network treats identity as a precious relic of economic commitment. If an attacker attempts to spawn the tide of fake nodes, the protocol forces the purchase of copper-level hardware or staked tokens, making the cost of creating a fraudulent majority prohibitively expensive relative to the expected protocol rewards.
